race.description: Sam Miranda Wines Dunstan Sprint Hcp (Bm66)
race.comment: HAZARDOUS (9) won his debut on this track, and has since won another 2 races at Albury, rushing through the grades. This is her toughest test to date, but with the aid of a 2kg claim from regular hoop Cassidy Hill, she can remain unbeaten. BRENLYN'S LEGACY (1) was a beaten favourite at Gundagai a fortnight ago, but had excuses when finishing midfield, although not far from the winner. He has to shoulder 62kg in this easier assignment but can still figure in the finish. Stick with him. BEFORE THE WAR (4) finished just ahead of the second pick in the same race at Gundagai last time out and will be peaking third up from a spell. He has won 4 times over this slightly longer trip and is ready to win again at short notice. ROSIE'S PROPHECY (10) won fresh up and won't find this much harder. A wide draw is the only query.
